"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/find-and-replace-pattern/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

890. Find and Replace Pattern

Given a list of strings words and a string pattern, return a list of words[i] that match pattern. You may return the answer in any order.

A word matches the pattern if there exists a permutation of letters p so that after replacing every letter x in the pattern with p(x), we get the desired word.

Recall that a permutation of letters is a bijection from letters to letters: every letter maps to another letter, and no two letters map to the same letter.

Example 1:

Input: words = ["abc","deq","mee","aqq","dkd","ccc"], pattern = "abb"
Output: ["mee","aqq"]
Explanation: "mee" matches the pattern because there is a permutation {a -> m, b -> e, ...}.
"ccc" does not match the pattern because {a -> c, b -> c, ...} is not a permutation, since a and b map to the same letter.

Example 2:

Input: words = ["a","b","c"], pattern = "a"
Output: ["a","b","c"]

Constraints:

    1 <= pattern.length <= 20
    1 <= words.length <= 50
    words[i].length == pattern.length
    pattern and words[i] are lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def findAndReplacePattern(self, words: List[str], pattern: str) -> List[str]:
        def matches(word: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
            if len(word) != len(pattern):
                return False
            p_to_w = {}
            w_to_p = {}
            for pc, wc in zip(pattern, word):
                if pc in p_to_w and p_to_w[pc] != wc:
                    return False
                if wc in w_to_p and w_to_p[wc] != pc:
                    return False
                p_to_w[pc] = wc
                w_to_p[wc] = pc
            return True

        return [word for word in words if matches(word, pattern)]


sol = Solution()

print(
    sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "deq", "mee", "aqq", "dkd", "ccc"], "abb")
)  # ["mee","aqq"]

assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "deq", "mee", "aqq", "dkd", "ccc"], "abb") == [
    "mee",
    "aqq",
]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["a", "b", "c"], "a") == ["a", "b", "c"]

assert sol.findAndReplacePattern([""], "") == [""]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["a" * 20, "b" * 20, "c" * 20], "a" * 20) == [
    "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
    "cccccccccccccccccccc",
]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abcde" * 4], "abcde" * 4) == ["abcdeabcdeabcdeabcde"]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "def", "ghi"], "xyz") == ["abc", "def", "ghi"]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["aaa", "bbb", "ccc"], "aaa") == ["aaa", "bbb", "ccc"]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "cba", "bac"], "abc") == ["abc", "cba", "bac"]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abcd", "abdc", "acbd", "acdb"], "abba") == []
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["xyz", "xyy", "xzz"], "foo") == ["xyy", "xzz"]
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "def", "ghi"], "aaa") == []
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "def", "ghi"], "aba") == []
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["abc", "def", "ghi"], "aab") == []
assert sol.findAndReplacePattern(["a" * 50, "b" * 50, "c" * 50], "a" * 50) == [
    "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
    "cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc",
]
